entities.name: Gaslight Swamp
entities.description: A swamp in Dominaria, south of King's Head, site of a bloody battle.

entities.name: Jaxle Brey
entities.description: Warmaster leading a King's Head battalion, wiped out and captured by goblins.

entities.name: Wolsey
entities.description: Scribe who defected to the goblins, took their throne, and captured Brey.

entities.name: Goblins of Gaslight Swamp
entities.description: Goblins with rocksleds, kites and sappers, whose king was outwitted by Wolsey.

events.summary: Brey's battalion from King's Head meets goblins with inventions in Gaslight Swamp.
events.quote: The army led by Warmaster Jaxle Brey encountered goblins armed with various inventions

events.summary: Wolsey defects to the goblins, takes their throne, has Brey's force wiped out and captures Brey.
events.quote: cleverly outwitting their king and taking the throne for himself

relations.note: Wolsey hated Brey and captured him to kill him.
relations.quote: In hatred of Brey, the scribe Wolsey defected to the side of the goblins
